players.product: ceramic ferrules and sleeves for optical connectors and devices

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 9,007,153,894.11, up 22.13% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 2,618,384,303.84, up 19.54%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 2,248,942,354.95, up 16.39%; operating cash flow RMB 2,877,609,076.65, up 19.74%. Overall gross margin 42.14% (down 0.84 points). Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 1,833,140,973.45, Q2 RMB 2,315,654,107.90, Q3 RMB 2,359,573,768.66, Q4 RMB 2,498,785,044.10; quarterly net profit attributable: Q1 RMB 532,651,401.44, Q2 RMB 704,486,482.59, Q3 RMB 721,381,208.34, Q4 RMB 659,865,211.47.

Revenue by product (annual report, 2025): electronic components RMB 3,308,089,586.22 (36.73% of revenue, up 43.95%, gross margin 42.30%, down 2.07 points); communication devices RMB 2,594,309,892.31 (28.80%, up 12.50%, gross margin 44.36%, up 0.43 points); electronic and ceramic materials RMB 1,959,378,016.92 (21.75%, up 16.82%, gross margin 38.09%, down 2.48 points); equipment components RMB 601,753,409.61 (up 12.09%). quarterly_data.signal: Optical communication (annual report): benefiting from faster global computing-infrastructure construction and a larger optical-device market, sales of the company's ceramic ferrules and related products grew further in 2025. New products - MT ferrules with guide pins and component sets for high-precision, high-stability fiber connection, and high-reliability ceramic packages designed for optical-chip packaging - were shown at major exhibitions; the company says its MT ferrules and ceramic package housings have been brought to market and have begun entering mainstream customers' supply chains.

Top five customers were 14.94% of 2025 sales (RMB 1,345,346,279.81); the largest 3.67%, then 3.64%, 3.13%, 2.26% and 2.24%; names not disclosed; related-party share 0.00%. Top five suppliers were 26.86% of 2025 purchases (RMB 1,005,824,993.02); the largest 6.74%, then 6.35%, 5.00%, 4.63% and 4.14%; names not disclosed; related-party share 0.00%.

quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): R&D spend RMB 653,436,680.10 in 2025, up 12.07%, 7.25% of revenue (none capitalised); 1,975 R&D staff. Projects: high-end electronic components and high-end multilayer chip inductors - some specifications have passed customer validation and begun small-batch supply; precision ceramic structural parts for the pan-semiconductor industry - some parts delivered in small batches.

Construction in progress was RMB 400,174,609.89 at end-2025 (from RMB 593,664,779.51). Major projects: Suzhou Three-Circle East China headquarters (budget RMB 160,000,000.00, 94.78% progress); Deyang new plant-area expansion (budget RMB 221,314,511.63); Glory Winner (Thailand) new plant area (budget RMB 91,000,000.00, 100.00% progress).
quarterly_data.figure: construction in progress RMB 400,174,609.89; Thailand plant 100.00%

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report; the company says the plan does not constitute a performance commitment to investors): fully improve MLCC materials and processes, keep breaking through on and mass-produce ultra-high-capacity large-size MLCCs and deepen cooperation with server and automotive-electronics customers, while developing top-tier customers and distributors; accelerate scaled sales of pan-semiconductor ceramic structural parts and bio-ceramics; speed up the expansion of overseas subsidiaries to further open overseas markets.

players.product: multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs), including high-capacity series

quarterly_data.signal: MLCC (annual report): the product line covers 0201 to 2220 standard sizes plus mid/high-voltage and automotive-grade products, with the patented M3L and 'S' series, flexible-electrode and high-frequency Cu inner-electrode products. As the server market grows and rising system performance and power consumption raise MLCC performance and usage requirements, the company's data-center supply capability rose step by step: it has launched multi-size high-capacity MLCCs and multi-specification high-capacity MLCCs for 48V power systems. The company says its MLCC applications have extended from home appliances to automotive electronics, base stations and servers, with certifications from several benchmark customers.
quarterly_data.figure: 0201 to 2220 sizes; high-capacity MLCCs for 48V power systems

quarterly_data.signal: Raised-fund high-capacity MLCC expansion project (annual report): committed investment RMB 375,000 ten-thousand (adjusted RMB 372,981.17 ten-thousand); RMB 49,136.11 ten-thousand invested in 2025 and RMB 130,115.32 ten-thousand cumulatively by end-2025; ready-for-use date May 31, 2027, postponed from May 10, 2025 to adapt to the external environment and keep the raised funds safe; implemented by Nanchong Three-Circle and Deyang Three-Circle.
